info.title: AI Workflow Assistant API
info.summary: Upload datasets, run AI-planned analyses computed with pandas, and export verified reports.

get.description: Readiness: the database and file storage are reachable and a model key is configured.
Readiness: the database and file storage are reachable and a model key is configured.

post.description: Create an account and start a session.
Start a session. The session token is set as an HttpOnly cookie.
End the current session. Safe to call when already signed out.
Change the password and sign out every other session.

get.description: Current usage against the account's limits.

post.description: Permanently delete the account with all datasets, analyses and reports.
Issue a short-lived credential for uploading a file directly to the API host.
Upload a dataset. It is validated, parsed, profiled and stored as Parquet.

409.description: The workbook has several sheets; resend with `sheet`.

delete.description: Delete the dataset and its stored file. Existing reports remain readable.

get.description: A page of rows from the dataset.
Starter questions derived from the dataset's columns.

post.description: Queue a new analysis of a dataset. Poll `/analyses/{id}/events` for progress.
Queue a follow-up question in an existing analysis conversation.

delete.description: Delete an analysis conversation together with its reports.

get.description: Status of the current turn plus progress events newer than `after`.

post.description: Cancel a queued or running turn. A running turn stops at its next checkpoint.

get.description: Download a report as Markdown, PDF or Excel, or one of its result tables as CSV.

Chart.title: Chart
Chart.description:
A chart specification the frontend can render directly.

For `heatmap`, each data point is `{"x": ..., "y": ..., "value": ...}`. For every other type,
each data point holds the `x_key` value plus one value per series key.

EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord
EvidenceRecord.description: One executed tool call: the provenance for the numbers in a report.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: 2-4 sentences. Every number must come from the cited evidence.

label.title: Label
label.description: Short name of the metric, e.g. 'Total revenue'.

value.title: Value
value.description: The value exactly as computed by a tool, formatted for reading.

context.title: Context
context.description: One short clause of context, or an empty string.

evidence_ids.title: Evidence Ids
evidence_ids.description: Ids of the tool results this value comes from.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why, tied to a finding. Do not introduce new statistics here.
